rules: How to ride: Roll the die, then tap any glowing square — the rails run both ways. Every track square is a quiz about the country. Stop in a town to hear its story, buy and invest in its businesses, sell them, and visit the stall for items. Own every business in a town and its income doubles 👑. Reach the destination first for a growing prize. Whoever falls farthest behind is haunted by a spirit of misfortune. Each month brings a real seasonal event. Richest traveler at the end wins.
